full_page.content:
c. 1950 July 28
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God Father Solanus Casey, O. P.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Indiana July 28th - just striking 102
Blessed be God in all His designs!
God bless you Miss Krausman and guide you on the way to good health, - God willing.
I just finished reading your welcome letter and thought I'd answer it at once before overlooking. I was in St. Joseph Hospi- tal, Ft. Wayne for two weeks but that was in June and I am back to St. Felix and feeling fine. Deo Gratias.
One trouble or weakness that we all have to guard against is worry. Instead of this weakness we do well to foster confidence in God. This we can do by not only patience, but by thanking God ahead of time for whatever He see best for us ... . We'll pray for your intentions too.
Sincerely yours in Christ
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
